notes: Manufacturing questions and unverified CAD pilots; not approvals. No print or slicer review evidence is recorded.

models.critical_fit_test: Measure intended laptop foot width, tilt-load stability, hinge retention and cable clearance
validation_actions: Create parametric hinges and flex/strength test specimen
Slicer-review bed support, span and orientation
Load-test with actual laptop before use

models.critical_fit_test: Verify stationery compartment actual opening and bottom drainage
validation_actions: Replace visual solid hex cells with CAD cavities
Check each well minimum wall thickness in slicer
Print a compartment and evaluate fit

models.critical_fit_test: Check drawer slide play, stack latch clearance and stop retention
validation_actions: Create CAD rails/stops with toleranced sliding fits
Slicer-check bridge regions and wall loops
Print two drawers and perform cycling test

models.critical_fit_test: Measure installation lip thickness and clip elastic fit
validation_actions: Compare clip channel to an actual sink/rail measurement
Slice lip-clip coupon and verify 2+ perimeter walls
Wet-load and cleaning/durability trial with printed pilot

models.critical_fit_test: Check removable caps, water traps, sanitary cleaning surfaces
validation_actions: Make drain paths open in watertight CAD
Review material suitability and cleaning protocol
Print water test and inspect crevices

models.critical_fit_test: Check detachable limbs and fragile antenna against intended scale
validation_actions: Simplify sub-nozzle components for the chosen scale
Prepare support orientation and color separation
Print a miniature and inspect fragility

models.critical_fit_test: Check watering-can spout, arms and petals for fragile islands
validation_actions: Thicken tiny limbs/foliage
Slicer-review overhangs and support scars
Print and manually inspect attachment strength

models.critical_fit_test: Check mushroom stems/gills and log bark are continuous print volumes
validation_actions: Boolean-union or deliberately separate caps and stems
Remove below-two-perimeter details
Print log fragment to assess support needs

models.critical_fit_test: Check all tidepool pieces attach to the base and water is decorative
validation_actions: Choose opaque printable water geometry instead of glass material
Join or key rocks and organisms
Review supports and paint plan

models.critical_fit_test: Check wheels' axles and cart-deck joining clearances
validation_actions: Create separate axle/rolling-wheel CAD components
Review wheel-to-frame fit and tip stability
Print-wheel fit and roll tests

models.critical_fit_test: Check frame hinge and wheel clearance; miniature not rideable
validation_actions: Model toleranced axle and folding joint in separate CAD parts
Slice fine spoke geometry conservatively
Print assembly and verify motion

models.critical_fit_test: Measure real MCU PCB and cable connector keep-out zones
validation_actions: Create parameterized authentic connector and PCB mounting datum
Slicer-check mounting posts and holes
Dry fit the actual board without powering it

models.critical_fit_test: Verify cable OD, minimum bend radius and charging device clearance
validation_actions: Create open channels with specified cable diameter
Check slots in slicer for bridging
Test actual cable insertion and strain

models.critical_fit_test: Verify seal and mounting points with actual sensor and solar module
validation_actions: Design real enclosure wall/boss geometry with clearances
Review outdoor UV/weather material needs
Test physical sensor fit and sealing

models.critical_fit_test: Check actual substrate adhesion, tile hole/edge sizing and fabric safety
validation_actions: Generate true flat 2.5D CAD and separate attachment zones
Slice on a fabric-printer profile or substrate coupon
Test flex, laundering and adhesion in material

models.critical_fit_test: Check joining clips, staking tip and soil exposure
validation_actions: Create mechanical clip and socket as separate CAD parts
Slicer-review vertical rod buckling and UV durability
Perform clip insertion and plant-load test

models.critical_fit_test: Check all lamp power/heat and diffuser separation
validation_actions: Create electrical-free standalone decorative geometry first
Do not mount near a powered lamp without heat/safety review
Test ambient heat only after electrical certification plan

models.critical_fit_test: Verify lid closure, carousel bearing and food-contact material claims
validation_actions: Create separate printed external stand; exclude food-contact jars
Check rotational clearance in CAD and slicer
Fit-test jar and bearing using known commercial containers

models.critical_fit_test: Check cone seat radius and wet-safe drainage route
validation_actions: Model measured holder diameter and drip-tray recess
Orient printed part to keep cups upright
Perform dry-fit and water splash test

models.critical_fit_test: Check perforation walls and modular support attachments
validation_actions: Boolean-union each louver perimeter into printable CAD
Analyze bridges at real size
Print one perforated test cell

models.critical_fit_test: Check glazing panel thickness, ridge vent and clip clearances
validation_actions: Use measured replaceable panels in CAD
Slicer-review roof overhangs and supports
Assemble physical mini-bay and check stability

models.critical_fit_test: Verify refuse-slot dimensions, door hinges and display inserts
validation_actions: Make service doors separate printables with fit gaps
Check edge radii and support
Build scale demonstration print

models.critical_fit_test: Check each door's fit, hinge pin and keypad tolerances
validation_actions: Split doors and frame with dimensioned hinges
Slicer-review repeated fine embossed labels
Print a door/frame coupon and test repeated access

models.critical_fit_test: Check actual caliper measurement jaw sizes and holder contact pressure
validation_actions: Measure caliper body and define protective seating geometry
Check FDM support soft contact pads
Fit-test with real caliper without flexing jaws

models.critical_fit_test: Validate actual 1/4in bit across-flats and fit allowance
validation_actions: Export OpenSCAD dock and three-clearance coupon
Slice pocket floors and outer walls before printing
Print coupon and test real bits before full holder

models.critical_fit_test: Measure actual wrist circumference and moving scale gaps
validation_actions: Create openable wearable CAD with safe radii
Avoid sharp thin detents and test skin-contact material
Print a scaled cuff and trial-fit without load

models.critical_fit_test: Not a load-rated hold; check mounting and human-safety labeling
validation_actions: Retain explicit non-load-bearing mini-diorama intent
Thicken color holds for printing if needed
Print a tabletop display only, never body-load test

models.critical_fit_test: Check paddle blade thickness, handle channel and ball seating
validation_actions: Caliper-measure real paddles and map support locations
Slicer-review ball seat and weight distribution
Dry fit and tip-over test

models.critical_fit_test: Check modular wheel pods, vault caps and fragile antenna
validation_actions: Define connection keys for detachable rover pods
Slicer-evaluate small joints and unsupported antenna
Print and assemble a scaled diorama

models.critical_fit_test: Check transparent shell separation and sample vials' tolerances
validation_actions: Design opaque printed dome support plus separately sourced lens
Slicer-review thin external arms
Print/display proof without pressure claims
